summary: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Items 5.02, 5.07, 8.01, and 9.01. The filing announces stockholder approval of an amendment to the 2021 Long-Term Incentive Plan, increasing shares available by 28.9 million, and provides voting results from the June 4, 2026 Annual Meeting where ten directors were elected. No special situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed; this is a routine governance update on compensatory plan approval and director elections. The filing is purely procedural with no deal terms or strategic event.
